name: Electronic Arts
summary:
Electronic Arts’ site is ea.com. The circular EA mark in the tab is the company favicon, distinct from a sports-game menu icon.

Checked 12 November 2026 against ea.com. HTML came from https://www.ea.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://www.ea.com/_next/static/media/favicon.3156aee2.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.ea.com/_next/static/media/favicon.3156aee2.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 101080 bytes. Directory sizes: 256×256, 128×128, 64×64, 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: ico-256x256-01.png at 256×256 (png, 1386 bytes) from https://www.ea.com/_next/static/media/favicon.3156aee2.ico.

files.dimensionNote: PNG payload inside the ICO. Not resized.
